currency.basis: The current official product page promotes the operating financial app and contains November 2026 tariffs; its linked stylesheet uses the candidate mark.

identity.basis: The official page names the same Moldcell Money product in Moldova and uses this mark on its product-home link.

assessment.independenceRationale: Product page, stylesheet and vector are one official source group; no independent corroboration is claimed.

variant.basis: The official product navigation directly uses the square SVG containing a circular purple gradient and yellow m/CG symbol. Gradient backing is meaningful to this sourced composition, not a uniform type-1 field, so preserve it without reshaping. Catalog conversion and actual small-size rendering remain to be checked.

candidate.detailsJudgement: The yellow m and CG details and purple gradient match the independent source on light and dark comparisons; no visible clipping.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Original circular disk and symbol placement are preserved; the full mark fits both square-cell renders.
candidate.rationale: Official Moldcell Money navigation mark provides a first icon for the matching existing product.
transforms: SVGO 4.1.0 with committed svgo.config.mjs SHA-256 f2a406e05dd8849e35cd5d2ce96862b6e160b135135064ceafd64efd126f477e reduced 8255 to 6519 bytes; selected optimized version after source comparison and desktop conversion. No intentional geometry, backing or color changes.
candidate.variant: Yellow m and CG on the original purple gradient circular field; the field is not a uniform type-1 background and is retained.
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: First addition: no icon existed at the frozen base; the final-only frames show the new mark on light and dark themes.

proposals.reason: The frozen record has no icon. The official product page uses an original standalone circular SVG for its Moldcell Money home navigation. A librsvg reference shows the yellow stylized m and CG mark on a purple gradient disk. Final converter and platform fidelity are not yet verified.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Original standalone product-navigation vector, used by the official Moldcell Money page; provides a first icon for the existing record.

sources.observation: Official product page describes Moldcell Money financial services, links its app stores and publishes tariffs effective November 2026. Its product-home navigation uses class icon; its linked product CSS binds that selector to the original SVG.
Official stylesheet references this standalone original SVG for the product-home navigation.
Product stylesheet specifies ../img/icon.svg for .tabs li a.icon; the retrieved SVG is the full original vector, not a raster tracing.
